serverInfo.name: blockchains-click
serverInfo.title: Blockchains.Click
serverInfo.description: Cross-chain crypto swap and multichain NFT marketplace aggregator. Chain lists, token prices and safety data, cross-chain swap price previews (Solana, EVM, Bitcoin), NFT collection data across Solana, EVM, and Sui/Aptos/Movement, and real blog content.

authentication.description: Public, read-only market data. No credentials required and no user data is accepted. Swap execution and NFT purchases require a connected wallet signature on the website and are not exposed through this server — see /auth.md.

tools.name: get_chains
tools.description: List the blockchains this app supports for cross-chain swaps.

tools.name: get_tokens
tools.description: List or search tokens on a given chain, or get that chain's trending tokens.

tools.name: get_token_price
tools.description: Get the current USD price for native SOL, native SUI, or an EVM native/ERC-20 token.

tools.name: get_token_safety
tools.description: Get RugCheck safety data and Jupiter market stats for a Solana token mint.

tools.name: get_swap_quote_preview
tools.description: Preview a Solana/EVM swap (Jupiter/Relay routing). Price preview only — cannot execute a trade.

tools.name: get_btc_sui_quote_preview
tools.description: Preview a swap involving Bitcoin or a non-Solana-to-Sui pair (ChangeNOW routing). Price preview only.

tools.name: get_nft_collection
tools.description: Get detail for a single NFT collection by vendor and slug.

tools.name: browse_nft_collections
tools.description: Browse NFT collections on a chain family (Solana, EVM, or a Move chain via Tradeport).

tools.name: get_platform_stats
tools.description: Get real, aggregate platform stats: total completed transactions and total USD volume.

tools.name: get_blog_posts
tools.description: List real blog posts — security write-ups, how-to swap guides, product deep-dives, NFT ecosystem coverage — optionally filtered by category or chain.

tools.name: get_blog_post_detail
tools.description: Get the full content of one blog post by slug.
